criteria.requirement: Fix configuration._format_input_factory to validate nested format-spec fields and conversions before the progress renderer starts. Permit only the existing allowed field names and conversions None/s/r/a at every parsed level, reject malformed braces, attribute/index traversal, unknown nested names and nested replacement depth beyond Formatter supported nesting. Preserve literal/escaped braces, valid dynamic width references and all existing bool/nonstring handling; return existing ERROR sentinel for invalid formats rather than deferring failures to a background render.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
